name: daily
description: Daily-once task runner for Claude Code: a SessionStart hook that runs registered shell tasks ([[task]] in ~/.daily/config.toml) at most once per calendar day and injects a summary of what ran. Skips while a /flow or /backlog driver is working (backlog lock), records each run to a JSONL report, and a failed task still counts as run (no retry until tomorrow). With no tasks registered it runs a default security audit (cargo deny check). Register/inspect with `daily add` / `daily list` / `daily report`; set enabled=false to disable. Subscription-native (one hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).
